scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of distributional phase convergence with reproducible finite checks; no claim of independent certification or first-ever discovery.
scientific_limitations: Applies to a one-dimensional single-particle telegraph process with symmetric unit speeds and deterministic positive continuous log-periodic reversal hazard.
Does not classify general quasiperiodic, feedback-dependent, multi-particle, or discrete-time switching rules.
No independent proof or publication-priority assessment has been performed; broader nonautonomous evolution-family results may subsume portions.
title: Phase-cycled ballistic laws for a logarithmically periodic telegraph process
